candidates.title: Open-set unknown-speaker rejection via calibrated per-profile thresholds plus background-cohort score normalisation
candidates.evidence: docs/research/PROFILE_LEARNING_CURVE.md already calibrates one accept threshold per profile at 5% dev false accept with frozen ECAPA; it uses only two speakers as negatives.
assumptions: A cohort of >= 20 non-target speakers exists in already-catalogued local speech
s-norm helps ECAPA at 1.5 s windows
candidates.falsifier: Offline: unknown-speaker false-accept at fixed 90% target recall with s-norm vs raw cosine on held-out speakers. Falsified if s-norm gains < 2 points absolute FA or loses recall > 3 points.
candidates.smallest_experiment: CPU, existing embeddings only, <10 min, no new audio, held-out source groups untouched.

candidates.title: Face/audio identity association using only transient, non-stored match scores (late fusion of a boolean 'same person' vote)
candidates.evidence: PLAN.md lists camera targeting as post-HackRU; no in-repo measurement of lip/face-to-voice association exists.
assumptions: Camera frames are processed in memory only; no embedding is persisted
Active-speaker detection transfers to a 640x360 25 fps wearable view
candidates.falsifier: Synthetic-free test needs real video; falsified if active-speaker precision at 1 s windows is below the audio-only ECAPA precision on the same clips.
candidates.smallest_experiment: Blocked on consented paired video; first step is a privacy design review (what is in RAM, for how long), no model run.

candidates.title: On-device personalisation with local-only profile updates: federated-free incremental prototype update with rollback
candidates.evidence: T-201 learning curve (1/2/4/8 examples) shows whether more examples help; mean prototype is already what hearing.tse.enrolled does.
candidates.falsifier: Replay sequential updates with 5% injected wrong-speaker confirmations; falsified if accept-threshold EER degrades more than the clean-update gain, i.e. poison outweighs benefit without a robust (median/trim) update.
candidates.smallest_experiment: CPU simulation on existing embeddings: trimmed-mean vs mean under 0/5/10% contaminated confirmations.

candidates.title: Beamforming (MVDR/delay-sum) as a front end, gated on actual multi-mic hardware
candidates.evidence: Pipeline is mono 16 kHz (PLAN ground rules); no recorded array data in repo.
assumptions: Target hardware exposes >= 2 synchronised mics with known geometry
candidates.falsifier: Does not apply until hardware exists. Gate: if the demo device exposes only one mic channel, close this branch with no work.
candidates.smallest_experiment: Check device channel count with a one-line capability query by a human (HEARING_HW_TESTS=1); no code before that.

candidates.title: User-feedback objective vs quality: learn a pairwise 'better/worse' preference and test agreement with SI-SDRi/wrong-speaker metrics
candidates.evidence: PLAN.md: 'Measure and listen, don't claim'; automatic preference learning is post-HackRU. Agreement between objective metrics and listeners is unmeasured here.
assumptions: Listener rankings available for a few dozen pairs
candidates.falsifier: Kendall tau between listener ranking and each metric over >= 30 pairs; falsified if every metric tau < 0.3, meaning metrics are not a usable proxy for the feedback objective.
candidates.smallest_experiment: Human rates 30 existing pair renders; CPU correlation script.

candidates.title: Separator fine-tune on target-room data (T-247 theory note)
candidates.evidence: docs/research/CONDITIONED_TSE_FEASIBILITY.md; Sol owns GPU; GPU cases capped globally at 300.
assumptions: Sol grants GPU slots before 08:00 Oct 10
candidates.falsifier: Smoke12 SI-SDRi gain < 0.5 dB over frozen baseline on non-heldout groups.
candidates.smallest_experiment: smoke12 GPU request through an overnight-gpu-request task.

candidates.title: Confidence calibration of speaker-match score for gating (T-249 theory note)
candidates.evidence: T-180 raised UNSURE_DB and gated-window floors; confidence thresholds are hand-set.
assumptions: Existing per-window scores with labels are available
candidates.falsifier: Expected calibration error after Platt/isotonic fit on dev vs raw; falsified if ECE improvement < 20% relative on held-out windows.
candidates.smallest_experiment: CPU Platt fit on logged window scores; share code path with N1.

candidates.title: Profile learning curve: 1/2/4/8 examples (T-201, already measured)
assumptions: Done; reused as the base for N1 and N3

candidates.title: Conditioned target-speaker extraction vs separate-then-select
assumptions: Weights licence allows use; GPU granted
candidates.falsifier: Wrong-speaker time at equal leak not lower than separate-then-select on smoke12.
candidates.smallest_experiment: smoke12 via existing eval harness; GPU request.

candidates.title: Gated-window floor policy (T-180 follow-up): learn floor dB from confidence
candidates.evidence: Commit 34e5673: 20 dB floor for gated windows, UNSURE_DB 6->12, adopted on measured wins.
candidates.falsifier: Replay: continuous floor(conf) not better than step floor on dropout+leak.
candidates.smallest_experiment: Offline replay of the existing eval harness with a mapped floor.
